links.passage: In fact, modern drip irrigation systems often incorporate sensors, automation, and controllers, allowing for dynamic adjustments to irrigation schedules and water delivery.
supporting_passages: Drip irrigation has expanded rapidly in the last decades as an efficient application method whereby soil evaporation and deep percolation are largely controlled (Alcaras et al., 2016; Zhang et al., 2017).
In fact, modern drip irrigation systems often incorporate sensors, automation, and controllers, allowing for dynamic adjustments to irrigation schedules and water delivery.
links.inference_note: The cited sentence establishes drip as an efficient, loss-controlling application method, and the adjacent sentence attributes dynamic control of irrigation schedules and water delivery to the sensors, automation and controllers built into modern drip systems.
